items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I told Maceo Mayfield, 'I'm very happy that we got in, and he didn't see us smokin' those cigarettes.' Because he'd always told me... if you're going to be an athlete, you can't be smokin'.

ctx.x: So we, as we were goin' up the street, we had two cigarettes that we had hooked in school. I had

started to hook in school, now. That we'd hooked in school, and we were goin' up the street and all of a sudden, Mayfield said to me, he said, "Jesus, there comes your father. There's your old man down the street." Well, we nearly choked these cigarettes, we choked them right quick and we put them in our pockets. And he come on down there, and he said, "Hiya boys, where you all goin'?" And we said, "Oh, we didn't have any class, so we were goin' up to -- up on Market Street to the Nickelle."
